mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.2% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing equity discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is active in any economic regime where the central bank maintains near-zero rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.2% (as of t-1mo), or Rank IC over 5 years remains <0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment exceeding 7.0% indicates labor market weakness that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0% (as of t-1mo), or Rank IC over 5 years <0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS < 0.2% and CPIAUCSL < 230 signals stable low-inflation monetary conditions that support equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (FEDFUNDS<0.2 and CPIAUCSL<230) produces positive returns in <40% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term <0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, housing starts above 1000 units signal robust consumer demand for housing, driving economic growth and corporate earnings that produce positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST signal fails to produce positive returns in >60% of late-cycle expansion instances, or Rank IC for HOUST in late-cycle <0.05.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth above 13700 billion dollars indicates strong economic activity that supports corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days in any economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when GDPC1 > 13700 (as of t-4mo), or Rank IC over 5 years <0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 99.0 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 99.0 (as of t-1mo), or Rank IC over 5 years <0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous PAYEMS > 135000 and UNRATE < 7.6% signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (PAYEMS>135000 and UNRATE<7.6) produces positive returns in <40% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term <0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 230), CPIAUCSL above 232 signals potential monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In CPIAUCSL > 230 regime, negative returns occur in <40% of cases, or Rank IC over 5 years <0.05.
